title: Markdown inventory table to RFC 4180 CSV
notes: Expected rows are the generator's data from which the Markdown table is rendered; the solution is written by csv.writer and parsed back. Traps: commas in Item, Location, price 1,249.00 and Notes; a double quote mid-field (3") and at a field start ("B/BB"); empty Notes cells; the alignment row with colons. The check parses with csv.reader(strict=True), drops trailing empty records and compares every field exactly.
